title: Combinatorial Invariance of Kazhdan-Lusztig Polynomials
exact_target: Does the unlabelled directed Bruhat graph of an interval determine its Kazhdan--Lusztig polynomial, independently of the surrounding Coxeter group?

sources.citation: Gurevich and Wang, Parabolic recursions for Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials and the hypercube decomposition, Selecta Mathematica (2024), Conjecture 5.1.
